I am Rev. Fr. A.P. Thirumahan, an old Patrician, privileged to lead my Alma Mater as her 24th Rector from 25th Jan. 2018. I had my primary education at my village, Point-Pedro and joined St. Patrick’s for the secondary education in 1990. I chose Commerce Stream for my Advanced Level study and was really lucky to learn under two great Rectors of the College, Rev. Fr. G.A. Francis Joseph and his successor Rev. Fr. A. I. Bernard. I was ordained as a priest in 2004. After a short period of pastoral work in different parishes, I was posted to St. Patrick’s in 2006. I was bursar, hostel warden, priest-in-charge for games and prefect of studies till I left for London for my Master’s in 2012. On my return from higher studies, I was appointed as Vice-Rector of the College. I was happy and privileged to work under Rev. Fr. M. Jero Selvanayagam as the Rector of the College, from whom I was able to learn many things which helped me a lot when I began my mission as Rector of the College. With the help of God’s grace and support of my colleagues and teachers I am serving my Alma Mater with joy and satisfaction.
